data.why: the repo ships compact sample subject trials at data/samples_compact/subject_01..03 plus an in-app 'Generate paper-style sample Subjects 1-3' button, so no additional data needs to be written or copied; files at app/data/samples_compact/subject_01/*.json can also be used directly as uploads in the Single subject tab since they already exist in /work/app

goals: Load the sample subject dataset and run the study pipeline to reproduce Table 2 demographics, Table 3 static angles, and Table 4 dynamic angles
Compute shoulder/hip joint angles (RS_θ, LS_θ, Δθs, RH_θ, LH_θ, Δθh) for static and dynamic trials
Review time-domain and STFT plots of joint angles across a walking trial to assess movement asymmetry over time
Check the FFT diagnostic note explaining why frequency-domain analysis is not meaningful for final interpretation
Read the healthy-vs-elevated-asymmetry inference summary to screen a subject's movement pattern
Build a single-subject report by uploading static/dynamic/sitting trial JSON files and reviewing the generated report

review.summary: The tree describes the batch reproduction workflow accurately, with good general/specific wording and screens that mostly match, but the single-subject path was never exercised with the trial files that ship in the repo. As a result, the FFT note, the per-subject plots and the report builder are all unconfirmed. Re-run the single-subject upload, correct two evidence citations, and mark the backend dropdown as cosmetic before filing.
